Definition: to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect
BiblicalUsage: Chaphah is covering, and it covers heads in grief and faces in judgment. David went up the ascent of Olivet weeping with his head covered, Haman hasted to his house mourning with his head covered, and when the king's word went out they covered Haman's face. In the temple the same word covers the house itself: Solomon overlaid the house with gold, and the beams and posts and doors were covered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe covering in Scripture is never neutral: David covers his head in sorrow, Haman covers his in shame, and God covers His house in gold. What covers a man tells you what has happened to him. I hold that the only covering that does not shame is the one God provides, and these verses show me all three kinds side by side.
